messages:
elaine_infra: FYI - at 08:29 we saw a sharp client surge and autoscaler failed to add GPUs in us-west1, user requests piling -> 503s and long tails. ops-bot posted the alert already.
ops-bot: Alert: cluster/us-west1 - pending pod queue > 420, scale_attempts=5, last_scale_latency=98s, reason=provisioning_timeout
pranav_sre: Seeing the same. The controller kept retrying but kube-provisioner logs show API 429s and a bunch of FAILED quota checks.
noah_runtime: Quick snapshot: queue depth spike to 180, aggregate token throughput doubled. Scaling decisions triggered, but node pool reconcile shows "no capacity found" for n1-gpu-preemptible.
maria_platform: Are we hitting a regional quota or a cloud-side maintenance? I can see multiple preemptible interrupts in the past 10m.
devops_bob: I grabbed the scaling-controller logs: ```2026-03-18T08:29:34Z scale-controller WARN scale failed provision attempt=3 reason="quota_exceeded: resourceLimitsExceeded"```
pranav_sre: That matches. Also seeing networking backpressure: kubelet egress errors to metadata server with timeouts around the same time. Could be transient network flap causing provisioning RPCs to fail.
elaine_infra: If provisioning RPCs are timing out, the controller will keep exponential backoff but the client queue grows. We ended up with a "scale hole" for ~4m. Need to shift traffic or fallback.
noah_runtime: Can we enable model-fallback to smaller replica in us-east1 and route new sessions there? latency jump but better than errors.
maria_platform: I initiated a traffic-shift to eu-west1 for new sessions (canary first) at 08:33. Will monitor error rate.
pranav_sre: For immediate mitigation: 1) open a manual node request (allocate non-preemptible) 2) reduce batch size to lower per-request resource needs 3) enable fallback routing. Any objections?
devops_bob: Manual node request submitted (ticket #INC-7291). Cloud console shows 6 x a2-highgpu provisioning in progress.
elaine_infra: Good. Also adjust autoscaler thresholds to be less aggressive on churn - the backoff is fine but the thrash came from quick scale-up/scale-down because probes failed. I'll push a temp policy bump.
ops-bot: Note: Scheduled maintenance window in us-west1 ended at 08:10, but some AZ repairs were ongoing. Related?
pranav_sre: Likely correlated. We saw higher control-plane latencies to the region between 08:20-08:35. That combined with preemptible scarcity created the hole.
noah_runtime: Logs from the runtime show many sessions falling back to CPU-only task and incurring 4-10x latency. Example trace: "kv_cache_miss -> queue_wait 320s -> fallback_cpu"
maria_platform: After shift, error rate dropped from 6.2% -> 1.1% in 4m. Latency med increased ~120ms avg for those users, acceptable for now.
devops_bob: Cost note: manual non-preemptible nodes will increase bill for the day. We should record as incident spend vs baseline.
elaine_infra: Action items: 1) pr to change autoscaler cooldowns and prefer non-preemptible when control-plane latency > X (elaine) 2) add metric for "provisioning_rpc_error_rate" (noah) 3) run a capacity-runbook to pre-reserve N GPUs for bursts (maria) 4) postmortem (pranav)
pranav_sre: I'll file the incident and start the postmortem template. Please add logs/graphs to the doc.
noah_runtime: I'll add a quick test to simulate metadata RPC timeouts to reproduce the scale hole locally.
maria_platform: I've left the canary shift on for 15m. Monitoring dashboard link: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/cluster/scale?orgId=1
elaine_infra: ETA for policy patch ~30m. We'll keep this thread updated. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
pranav_sre: Noted, I'll ping oncall if we see any regression after the patch.
ops-bot: Incident INC-7291 updated: manual nodes active at 08:40, cluster health stabilized at 08:43.
elaine_infra: Closing mitigation. Postmortem to follow with recommendations: preferring non-preemptible during noisy control-plane windows, adding guardrails for circuit-breaking autoscaler retries, and regional capacity reservations.
pranav_sre: +1. Adding a cost estimate for the manual nodes in the postmortem.
noah_runtime: Will include simulation results.
maria_platform: I'll schedule a follow-up on capacity bookings next week.
elaine_infra: Thanks everyone.
